verdict.rationale: Ollama runs on Apple Silicon via llama.cpp's Metal backend, and community benchmarks show working GPU-accelerated inference (e.g., 30-84 tok/s on M4 Pro), but comments note it 'was basically shelling out to llama.cpp' rather than a native MLX/ARM-optimized backend, and another user reports notably slow performance on a MacBook Pro versus LM Studio. No vendor documentation in the pack explicitly claims dedicated Apple Silicon/Metal optimization work.
